title: Implement MiniLMEmbedder: all-MiniLM-L6-v2 via tract ONNX + tokenizer
description:
**Files:** `Cargo.toml` (core dependencies, NO cargo feature per the decision: tract-onnx, tokenizers); `src/store/embed_minilm.rs` (naming per final layout); `src/store/embed.rs` (trait unchanged); `src/spec/ch02_querying.rs`.

**Acceptance:** tract ONNX runtime on CPU, all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim), wordpiece tokenization via the tokenizers crate, implementing `Embedder` (model id "all-MiniLM-L6-v2"); batch embedding at ingest (the scanner-batch milestone). One model, one set of weights, one engine — vectors consistent by construction; the store's model-id policy from the vector-search task applies (mismatch refused, clean re-ingest). The 50–200 ms CPU query-embedding target is a doc note, not a spec assertion. Per the maintainer's decision (BOTSPY-bb60bb closed): real MiniLM is the shipped embedder, in core (no cargo feature), loading weights + tokenizer from the local cache (see BOTSPY-c3cf41); clean typed error when setup has not run (files missing); the deterministic stub remains only as an internal unit-test seam; real-model specs exercise the embedder ungated.

comments.author: example-user
comments.text: Done: MiniLMEmbedder — all-MiniLM-L6-v2 through tract ONNX on CPU (fp32 graph, DefaultRuntime), mean-pooling weighted by the attention mask, 384-dim vectors; real-model sanity margin tightened to cos(paraphrase) − cos(unrelated) ≥ 0.3 (0.56 vs 0.02). Committed to feat/local-store (3e6b787, PR #4).
